reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE below 77,480.0. That is 490.3 points below spot, 1.16 hourly ATRs on a 421.40 reading, and it sits a deliberate 0.15-ATR buffer beneath the 1H EMA50 at 77,566.27, the 1H EMA200 at 77,552.42 and the 77,560.0 gate that armed this move. Those three levels are within fifteen points of each other and together they ARE the reclaim; losing them on a settled basis means the reclaim failed rather than was probed, and the bullish read in this report is finished.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE above 78,240.0. That clears the 78,176.1 twenty-four-hour high by a 0.15-ATR buffer of 63.2 points. Above it the realized-liquidation tape is close to empty - 350,998 USD at 78,000 and 61,275 USD at 78,250 against 2,026,487 USD in the single 77,250 bucket below - so a settled break has very little resting flow to absorb it before the 4H twenty-bar high at 79,256.0.

decisionBox.changed: The stance flips from REDUCE to ADD because the gate endday wrote did its job. Endday read range-bear at 77,104.0 with price below all four 15m EMAs and all four 1H EMAs, and set an add gate at 77,560.0 clearing the session high, the 1H EMA200 and the 1H EMA50 at once. The 02:00 UTC hourly bar settled at 77,820.0, 260 points through it, and price has since printed 78,176.1 and holds 77,970.3. Every 15m EMA (20 at 77,622.91, 50 at 77,474.07, 100 at 77,417.78, 200 at 77,547.07) and every 1H EMA (20 at 77,465.85, 50 at 77,566.27, 100 at 77,807.46, 200 at 77,552.42) now sits BENEATH spot, the 4H histogram has narrowed from -89.28 to -46.43 and price has recovered the 4H EMA20 at 77,775.46. Two things hold the confidence at 6.0 rather than higher. Open interest FELL 15,217,232 USD from endday to 2,224,227,959 while price rose 866.3 points, which is short covering rather than fresh long demand, and the last six hours of the liquidation tape ran 1,928,612 USD of shorts against 1,523,272 USD of longs - a squeeze burns its own fuel. And the daily MACD histogram crossed bearish yesterday at -92.63 from +89.80. So this is a real reclaim expressed in spot only: deploy a 22 USDT tranche of idle cash into the long-term core, no leverage in either direction.

All read in-page over the live okx.com origin.
liquidityMagnet.note: Pull is UP on flow, not on mass. The heaviest mass is unambiguously below - 2,026,487 USD at 77,250 - but that is REALIZED flow already consumed on the way down, and the last six hours reversed the sign: 1,928,612 USD of short liquidations against 1,523,272 USD of long, which is the squeeze that carried price through 77,560 and up to 78,176.1. Above spot the tape is close to empty, so there is very little to absorb a continuation. The honest caveat is that this feed is backward-looking - it records where forced flow HAS occurred, not where stops are resting - and short-covering fuel is finite.

calibration.note: Endday's reduce gate at 76,600.0 never came close - the session low was 76,963.2, some 363.2 points above it. Its add gate at 77,560.0 armed on the 02:00 UTC close at 77,820.0 and price is 410.3 points above that gate now, so acting on the rule paid roughly +0.53 percent on anything added at the trigger. That is the fourth consecutive settled-close gate to be correct, against three discretionary entries in a row that lost money. The lesson stands: the rules are working, the improvisation between them is not.
